captions.text: We had permission to take one thing. Kit brought a saw. I brought the little blue bowl.
captions.speaker: Nell

captions.text: Count from the chimney. Four rows east.
captions.speaker: Kit

captions.text: You can put that map away. I know where I fell out of a tree.
captions.speaker: Nell

captions.text: Under the boat it was still autumn. Leaves caught flat against the wire. A wasp inside a pear, perfectly still.
captions.speaker: Nell

captions.text: Two tugs if you want me to pull.
captions.speaker: Kit

captions.text: I went down with the saw between my knees. The brass plate was exactly where we'd left it.
captions.speaker: Nell

captions.text: Kit. September, four feet one. Nell. September, four feet one and a half. She'd scratched that half in herself, for me.
captions.speaker: Nell

captions.text: I put the saw to the bark. Then something hit the back of my hand. A pear, coming up. And then another.
captions.speaker: Nell

captions.text: You made me row six miles.
captions.speaker: Kit

captions.text: We split the last pear with her thumbnail. The flesh was salt all the way through. In the middle, six brown seeds.
captions.speaker: Nell

captions.text: Your kitchen gets the morning sun.
captions.speaker: Kit

captions.text: She pushed five seeds across the table. The sixth she slid into her shirt pocket.
captions.speaker: Nell
